Metadata.title: Moringa · A fair of things made by hand
Metadata.description: Handmade pieces from Brazil, with the story of who made them. Buy straight from ceramists, weavers and woodworkers across the country.

Header.bag: {count, plural, =0 {Bag, empty} one {Bag, # piece} other {Bag, # pieces}}

Home.title: Handmade in Brazil, with the story of who made it.
Home.intro: Pieces from {makers} makers in {states} states. Every purchase goes straight to the person who made it.

Piece.stock: {count, plural, =0 {Sold out} one {Last one available} other {# available}}
Piece.limited: We only have {count} of this piece. Your bag now holds {count}.

Footer.tagline: An online fair for people who make things by hand in Brazil.
Footer.madeBy: Made with care by Rayssa Roberta.
Footer.demo: Portfolio project: payments use Stripe test mode and nothing is charged.

NotFound.title: This page is not at the fair.
NotFound.body: Maybe the address changed, or the piece already found a home.

Catalog.title: Pieces
Catalog.description: Ceramics, basketry, embroidery and woodwork made by hand by artisans all over Brazil.
Catalog.count: {count, plural, =0 {No pieces} one {# piece} other {# pieces}}
Catalog.emptyTitle: No pieces match these filters yet.
Catalog.emptyBody: Try another region or price range. New pieces arrive at the fair every week.

Shops.title: Makers
Shops.description: The artisans who sell on Moringa. Every shop tells the story of the person behind the pieces.
Shops.pieceCount: {count, plural, =0 {No pieces yet} one {# piece} other {# pieces}}
Shops.empty: {name} has not published any pieces yet. Come back soon!

Bag.title: Bag
Bag.emptyBody: Take a walk around the fair. Ceramics, baskets and embroidery are waiting for a new home.
Bag.packageNote: Each maker ships their pieces in one package, so shipping is charged once per shop.

Checkout.title: Delivery and payment
Checkout.name: Full name
Checkout.emailHint: We send the confirmation and tracking code here.
Checkout.cepHint: We fill in the address for you.
Checkout.cepNotFound: CEP not found. You can type the address yourself.
Checkout.cepOffline: We could not check the CEP right now. You can type the address yourself.
Checkout.stripeNote: Payment happens on Stripe's page, by card or Pix. This is a portfolio project: use the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, nothing is really charged.
Checkout.errorSummary: {count, plural, one {Check the highlighted field.} other {Check the # highlighted fields.}}
Checkout.stockProblem: Some pieces changed stock while you were shopping. We adjusted your bag, take a look before paying.
Checkout.paymentProblem: We could not open the payment right now. Your bag is still here, try again in a moment.
Checkout.invalidProblem: Some details did not pass our check. Review the form and try again.

errors.name: Write your full name.
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.cep: Enter the 8 digits of the CEP, like 01310-100.

Checkout.demoNote: You are in Marina's demo account, so her made-up address is already filled in. Please do not use real details here.

Order.paidBody: We told the {count, plural, one {maker} other {makers}} and they will start preparing soon. You will get the tracking code by email.
Order.pixBody: As soon as the bank confirms the payment, your order goes to the people who made the pieces. It usually takes a few seconds.
Order.demoBody: This environment has no Stripe key, so the payment was simulated and nothing was charged.
Order.openBody: Your bag is saved. You can try again whenever you like.
Order.thanks: Thank you for buying from people who make by hand.
Order.guestHint: Keep the code: with it and your checkout email you can follow the order under “Track an order”, in the footer.

Account.title: My account
Account.signInTitle: Sign in to follow your orders.
Account.signInBody: On Moringa you see every step of your order, from payment to your door, without having to ask the maker.
Account.demoBody: Sign in as Marina, a sample buyer with three orders at different stages. No password needed and nothing is real.
Account.noOrders: You have not placed any orders yet.
Account.noOrdersBody: Once you buy something, this is where you follow it.
Account.loadError: We could not load your orders right now.

OrderPage.title: Order {code}
OrderPage.delivered: Delivered. We are glad it arrived!
OrderPage.pendingNote: As soon as the payment is confirmed, the order goes to {maker}.
OrderPage.canceledNote: This order was canceled and nothing was charged.
OrderPage.confirmed: Thank you for confirming! {maker} will be happy to know.
OrderPage.confirmError: We could not confirm right now. Try again in a moment.
OrderPage.liveNote: This page updates by itself when the order changes.
OrderPage.notFound: We could not find this order in your account.

Seller.title: My shop
Seller.landingTitle: Sell what you make by hand
Seller.landingBody: On Moringa, your shop tells your story and every sale goes straight to you. Try the maker area with a demo account:
Seller.demoLuciaHint: A ceramist in Cunha, SP, with a shop and published pieces.
Seller.demoNewHint: Create your shop from scratch and publish your first piece.
Seller.demoNote: Demo accounts: what you create is visible only to you and is deleted after 7 days.
Seller.buyerSignedIn: You are signed in as a buyer. To see the maker area, sign out and use a maker account.
Seller.noPieces: You have not published any pieces yet.
Seller.noPiecesBody: Start with the piece you like the most. It takes about three minutes.
Seller.publishedDemo: In the demo account, it is visible only to you.
Seller.shopCreatedBody: Now publish your first piece. Visitors to your page will get to know your story.
Seller.onboardingIntro: Tell buyers who you are and where you come from. That is what makes someone choose your piece.
Seller.shopNameHint: It can be your name, like “Dona Lúcia”, or your studio's name.
Seller.storyHint: How you learned, what inspires you. At least 40 characters.
Seller.quoteHint: It is highlighted on your page.
Seller.english: Want to write in English too? (optional)
Seller.englishHint: Visitors who read Moringa in English see this version. If you leave it blank, we show the Portuguese.
Seller.descriptionHint: Size, how it was made, care. At least 20 characters.
Seller.stock: How many do you have ready?
Seller.stockHint: Use 0 if it is made to order.
Seller.previewIntro: This is how buyers will see your piece.
Seller.draftRestored: We restored the draft you started.
Seller.previewBanner: Preview: this is how buyers see this page.
Seller.previewDemo: In the demo account, only you can see this page.
Seller.previewAction: In the live shop, the “Add to bag” button shows here.

errors.story: Tell a little more: at least 40 characters.
errors.pieceName: Give the piece a name of at least 3 letters.
errors.description: Describe the piece in at least 20 characters.
errors.pricePositive: The price must be more than zero.
errors.priceTooHigh: That seems too high. Please check.
errors.shippingRequired: Enter the shipping. Use 0 for free shipping.
errors.stockRequired: Enter how many pieces you have.
errors.generic: We could not save right now. Your details are still here, please try again.

Seller.inStock: {count, plural, =0 {Made to order} other {# in stock}}

Lookup.title: Track an order
Lookup.intro: Enter the order code and the email you used at checkout. The code is on the confirmation page and in the email we sent you.
Lookup.signInInstead: Bought while signed in? See My account.
Lookup.codeHint: Starts with MOR-, for example MOR-7KQ2XA.
Lookup.codeError: Enter the full code, like MOR-7KQ2XA.
Lookup.emailHint: The same one you used at checkout.
Lookup.notFound: We could not find an order with that code and email. Check both and try again.

Status.title: System status
Status.intro: What is configured in this environment. Yes or no only: no keys are shown here.

database.name: Database (Neon)
database.ok: Connected. Orders, accounts and pieces are saved.
database.off: No DATABASE_URL: the site uses the sample catalog and does not save orders.
database.error: DATABASE_URL is set, but the connection failed. Check the value on Vercel.

auth.name: Sign-in (Auth.js)
auth.ok: AUTH_SECRET is set. The demo sign-in works.
auth.off: AUTH_SECRET is missing on Vercel: sign-in does not work live.

stripe.name: Payments (Stripe, test mode)
stripe.ok: Test key found. Checkout opens Stripe's page.
stripe.error: This is not a test key. Moringa only accepts sk_test_ keys.

webhook.name: Stripe webhook
webhook.ok: Webhook secret set. Confirmed payments move the order to Paid.
webhook.off: No STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: orders stay as Awaiting payment.
webhook.error: The secret should start with whsec_. Check the value on Vercel.

siteUrl.name: Site address
siteUrl.ok: Set. Shared links show the right image.
siteUrl.off: No address: shared links may show no image.

ShopOrders.toShipHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting today.} one {# order waiting for you.} other {# orders waiting for you.}}
ShopOrders.chartEmpty: No sales in the last 8 weeks yet.
ShopOrders.emptyToShip: Everything is shipped. Take a breath!
ShopOrders.emptyShipped: No orders on the way right now.
ShopOrders.shipDialogBody: Paste the Correios tracking code. {buyer} sees it right away on the order page.
ShopOrders.trackingError: That does not look like a Correios code. Check it: 2 letters, 9 digits and 2 letters.
ShopOrders.shippedDone: Order {code} shipped! {buyer} can now follow the delivery.
ShopOrders.actionError: We could not update order {code}. Please try again.
ShopOrders.conflict: Order {code} had already changed. We refreshed the list.
ShopOrders.loadError: We could not load the orders.
ShopOrders.demoOrders: In the demo, these orders come from made-up buyers and only show in this browser. Buy something as Marina in this same browser and the order shows up here.
